# docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured 0.9 s at 100 lines, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.
# Inventory reservation load test (2026-09-08)
Run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 (reservations are now batched). p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0.5 s |
| 100 | 0.9 s |
| 150 | 1.7 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

steps.message: The 2024 ADR's 60 is stale. The reservation service was replaced in 2026-09, and the new load test shows 0.9 s p99 at 100 lines. I'll keep 100, mark the ADR superseded, and record the decision.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: "max_items.default: 100"
status: final
evidence: [docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md, docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md, config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md]
---
Two values existed: 60 (ADR 0007, from the 2024-08 load test, where p99 reservation latency was 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against the 2.0 s checkout timeout) and 100 (config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md, from the 2026-09 load test). The 2024 measurements described the old reservation service. It was replaced on 2026-09-01 with batched reservations, and the new test measured 0.9 s p99 at 100 lines (1.7 s at 150), under the timeout. The 60 limit's grounds no longer hold, while 100 is backed by current measurements, so 100 is adopted. ADR 0007 is marked superseded.
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md'
s=open(p).read().replace("Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)","Status: Superseded by docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md (limit is now 100; the reservation service was replaced in 2026-09)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git add -A; git commit -qm "docs: resolve cart item limit at 100, supersede ADR 0007

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"; git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
The cart item limit is now 100 everywhere, and I recorded the decision in `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md`. I made two local commits and haven't pushed them or commented on issue #12.

- **Why 100:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100. They rest on the 2026-09 load test, run after the reservation service was replaced and reservations were batched. It measured 0.9 s p99 at 100 lines, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
- **Why not 60:** ADR 0007 said 60, based on the 2024-08 load test of the old service (3.9 s at 80 lines, 7.2 s at 100). That service no longer exists, so those numbers no longer apply.
- **ADR 0007:** its status now reads "Superseded by docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md".
- **Tests:** I didn't run any, since only docs and a record changed.
